name: Domaine Pierre Usseglio & Fils Châteauneuf-du-Pape Réserve des Deux Frères 2016
text:
## Usseglio Réserve des Deux Frères 2016

**Story.** The estate was founded by Francis Usseglio, who left Italy for [Châteauneuf-du-Pape](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Chateauneuf-du-Pape,+France&t=k) in 1948. His first vintage followed a year later, and his sons Jean-Pierre and Thierry now run it. The Deux Frères is 100% Grenache, aged in oak, which makes it the most modern-styled of the estate's wines.

**Reviews.** Jeb Dunnuck gives the 2016 a perfect 100, checked on his site. He calls it deeper and darker than the Mon Aïeul and advises short-term cellaring, then about two decades. Falstaff (Ulrich Sautter, 2019) gave it 94 points. The Wine Advocate (Joe Czerwinski) tasted it from barrel. A UK merchant's page shows a 94–96 header but 96–98 in the note itself, so I can't say which is right, and I found no final bottled Wine Advocate score. Falstaff lists this wine at 16.5% alcohol. CellarTracker community score, from your list: 96.2 (2016).

**Practical note.** John Livingstone-Learmonth thought the oak would need until 2022 to settle. It is now ten years old, so it should be open for business. Decant for an hour or two. Lamb shoulder with garrigue herbs would suit it.

**Curious aside: the pebbles.** The famous galets roulés of Châteauneuf are quartzite stones smoothed by the Rhône that hold daytime heat and release it at night. The appellation gets about 2,800 sun hours a year, and the mistral keeps the air dry.

### From the history books
- 1309: Pope Clement V moved the papal court to Avignon, which began the [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy). [Avignon](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Avignon,+France&t=k) is the city beside the vineyards.
- 15 May 1936: Châteauneuf-du-Pape became one of France's first six AOCs. See [Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC).
- 1948: Francis Usseglio arrives. See [this Wikipedia search](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape+wine+Usseglio&go=Go).

**Sources:** Jeb Dunnuck (subscriber site, checked directly), Uncorked, Falstaff, Farr Vintners, J.J. Buckley, Vinfolio, FRW, First Bottle, Kysela, Benchmark Wine, K&L, Whwc, Thatchers, Winewithseth, CellarTracker, Delectable, closdesspiritueux.com, and Wikipedia ([Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC), [Nahe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahe_(wine_region)), [Vouvray AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouvray_AOC), [La Clape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massif_de_la_Clape), [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy), [Great French Wine Blight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_French_Wine_Blight)).
